full_judgment: By this time it has been settled in number of cases that in a case of wife killing, onus is on the shoulder of husband to explain the cause of death, if any wife dies at her husband’s house. In the absence of any explanation from the husband, irresistible presumption is that the husband is responsible for her death. [reliance placed on Sudhir Kumar Das alias Khudi Vs. The State, 60 DLR 261; Shah Alam Vs. The State, 5 BLC 492; Gouranga Kumar Saha Vs. State, 2 BLC (AD) 126; Abdul Motaleb Howlader Vs. State, 5 MLR (AD) 362; Dipak Kumar Sarker Vs. State, 40 DLR (AD) 139].
